name: انزوای دورکاری
description: A remote worker who feels isolated, misses colleagues, and asks how to not be alone while working from home. Verifies the isolation disclosure opens the work thread and the follow-up question routes to loneliness.

turns.text: از خونه کار می‌کنم و کاملاً احساس انزوا می‌کنم
دورکاری تنهاییه، دلم برای همکارها تنگ شده

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the work thread for isolation. Turn 2 moves to loneliness for missing colleagues. Turn 3 answers the solitude question from the loneliness thread.
expected.behavior: Persian remote-work isolation gets the same two-thread care as English, and the practical question never falls to a generic fallback.
